classification_rationale: Trigger reuses the custom predicate scoped for req-1-self-destruct (S). Notably, Slither's OWN `suicidal` detector -- explicitly rejected as a match for the S-level mere-presence check -- is actually the RIGHT tool here: its `is_protected()` heuristic is direct evidence for THIS M-level requirement's 'only authorised parties can call' condition. A good example of a detector being the wrong fit at one level and the right fit one level up.
